notes: Not player-facing: the SYSERR goes to perror() on the server console (src/objsave.c:160-161) and needs an fopen failure whose errno is not ENOENT — the deletion paths run with a valid name on a writable directory, so only the clean ENOENT case occurs (R5e).
Not player-facing: the SYSERR goes to perror() on the server console (src/objsave.c:169-170) and needs an unlink failure whose errno is not ENOENT, which the registered paths never produce (R5e).
